ns2:section.sectionText: Infrastructure Sensing Lab Course description: Students will learn basic strategies for experimental design, and gain experience working with a variety of CEE sensing techniques; with components in experimental design and approaches to terrestrial, field, and laboratory-based measurements and experiential learning to explore sensor types and technologies. The course will have modules on 4 sensing applications: (1) mechanics and materials, (2) water and environment, (3) transportation, and (4) construction. Restricted to online non-degree, online MCS, online MSME and online MSCEE students. For more details on this course section, please see http://engineering.illinois.edu/online/courses. Non-Degree students may enroll on a space-available basis with consent of Program Coordinator, Meg Griffin (mgriffin@illinois.edu).
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: Civil Engr - Online - UIUC, MCS:Computer Sci Online -UIUC, MS:Industrial Engr Online-UIUC, MS:Mechanical Engineerng -UIUC, MS:Env Engr CivilEngr ONL-UIUC, MS: Aerospace Engr-Online-UIUC, NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC, NDEG:Undergrad Nondeg-CE-UIUC, or MENG:Mech Engineering Onl-UIUC.
